name: Haus Zeller
beschreibung: The Haus Zeller welcomes visitors to the charming village centre of Nesselwängle in Tyrol's scenic Tannheimer Tal. Styled in authentic alpine woodwork, the cosy guest rooms feature private en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and sunny balconies boasting open views of the Allgäu Alps. In the morning, a delicious breakfast buffet packed with local regional produce is served in the friendly breakfast parlour. The guesthouse serves as an ideal launchpad for outdoor activities: summer brings high-altitude hikes up to the Krinnen pastures, via ferratas, and refreshing swimming at nearby Lake Haldensee. In winter, valley cross-country ski tracks pass right by and local ski slopes cater superbly to families.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine guesthouse in the centre of Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal with traditional rooms and near Lake Haldensee.
